name: Easy Slow Cooker Seafood Cioppino with Shrimp, Cod, Clams & Rustic Bread

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 stick celery
½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and medium dice carrots. Trim and medium dice celery. Peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Place all three in a 6-quart slow cooker insert.
Add tomatoes, clam juice, tomato paste, water, minced garlic, oil, and spices to the slow cooker, then stir to combine. Cover slow cooker and cook until veggies are tender, 4-5 hours on LOW.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (14.5 oz) can diced tomatoes
1 (8 fl oz) bottle clam juice
1 (6 oz) can tomato paste
1 tbsp minced garlic
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are tender, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Pat cod dry with paper towels, large dice, then season with salt and pepper. Add to the slow cooker, along with shrimp and chopped clams (do not drain), then stir to combine the cioppino. Continue to cook until cod and shrimp are cooked through, 30 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lb cod fillet
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
2 (6.5 oz) can chopped clams (in juice)

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.
Slice bread and toast if desired.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (24 oz) loaf rustic bread loaf

instructions.primary_message: Divide cioppino between bowls. Drizzle with vinegar and sprinkle with parsley. Serve with bread and enjoy!
